events.body: Regional banking institution Bank of Hawaii (NYSE:BOH) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q1 CY2026, with sales up 13.1% year on year to $195 million. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.30 per share was 3% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
